# residualize y and spline basis on H
def resid(a, H):
    beta,_,_,_ = np.linalg.lstsq(H, a, rcond=None)
    return a - H@beta

    # regress yr on Br
    beta,_,_,_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Br, yr, rcond=None)
    pred = Br@beta
    ss_res = ((yr-pred)**2).sum()
    ss_tot = (yr**2).sum()
    r2 = 1-ss_res/ss_tot
    k = Br.shape[1]; n = len(yr); p = H.shape[1]
    F = (r2/k)/((1-r2)/(n-p-k))

    pv = 1-stats.f.cdf(F, k, n-p-k)

    errs=[]

for k in range(5):
    tr=d[folds!=k]; te=d[folds==k]
    mm=smf.ols('recovery_score ~ C(hospital)',data=tr).fit()
    errs.append(((te['recovery_score']-mm.predict(te))**2).mean())
print("baseline CV MSE", np.mean(errs))
